description: This file defines the ResourcesNotAccessibleException class, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that resources could not be loaded due to missing authorization. It includes methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and a builder class for constructing exceptions with specific properties.

classes.name: ResourcesNotAccessibleException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that resources could not be loaded due to missing authorization. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements PolicyException, providing static factory methods and a builder pattern for instantiation.

classes.name: ResourcesNotAccessibleException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing ResourcesNotAccessibleException instances with customizable properties like message, description, cause, and href.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a ResourcesNotAccessibleException from a simple message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ResourcesNotAccessibleException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated DittoHeaders.
